name: @brain/lib-logger
description: Brain's shared structured-logging primitive. One pino config used by every TS service (api-gateway, core-service, web). Enforces JSON-to-stdout, ISO timestamps, level-from-env, and the canonical PII-redact path list (DPDP minimization). Exports correlation-extract helpers so the request_id + trace_id + workspace_id + user_id 4-tuple flows end-to-end.
